Follows Claude Code 2.1.330: `/desk-monitor` and opening a preview in the browser keep working where `$.session.machine` is refused.

- **`$.session.machine` refused**: since 2.1.330, on the server (not the CLI) where tools run in another container, that container answers the call or the call rejects. desk-look now treats a refusal as an unknown system instead of failing: `/desk-monitor` still opens and says it works on Linux only (this computer: unknown) without reading `/proc`, and `o` in the preview pane opens the page with `xdg-open`. The refusal is not remembered, so the monitor asks again next time
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.81.7 with no other change

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
